dyadID.Description: ID number for each dyad. Same generation dyads are in range 1001-1030 and intergenerational dyads are in range 2001-2031.

task.Description: The task being completed by the dyad.

nFrame.Description: Number of frame in video recording.

bodypart.Description: Name of body part to which coordinates belong.

x_p1.Description: X coordinate (in pixels) of given body part belonging to participant 1 of a given dyad.

y_p1.Description: Y coordinate (in pixels) of given body part belonging to participant 1 of a given dyad.

c_p1.Description: Level of confidence in given coordinates pair (x and y) for participant 1 returned by the open pose model.

x_p2.Description: X coordinate (in pixels) of given body part belonging to participant 2 of a given dyad.

y_p2.Description: Y coordinate (in pixels) of given body part belonging to participant 2 of a given dyad.

c_p2.Description: Level of confidence in given coordinates pair (x and y) for participant 2 returned by the open pose model.
